notes.title: Patch
notes.content:
- Fixes in the save system.

- Bug fixes.

notes.title: Patch improvements
notes.content:
- Changes in the control to run, now you have to press the joystick or shift for the character to run, and press it again to walk.

- Changes in the speed of the character in standard game, the speed has been increased both when running and when walking.

- Fixed bugs in reference to the save system.

notes.title: Bug Fixes
notes.content:
- Standard screen: Fixed an error that prevented progress.

- VR: Fixed a bug that prevented the levers from being used.

notes.title: Patch 1.3
notes.content:
- Change in the system of grabbing objects. Now, the hands disappear and the object does not teleport towards them, achieving a more natural grip sensation.

- The grappling distance has been changed to be able to grab objects on the ground more easily.

- Collisions have been improved.

- Changed the way the options menu appears and it now follows the player.

- Several bugs have been corrected.

notes.title: Bug Fixes
notes.content:
- Fixed a bug with the left grip in VR.
- Bug Fixes.

notes.title: Patch 1.1
notes.content:
- Fixed a bug that made the screen black in some areas for VR.

- Added indicators at level 1.

- Fixes in mapping for headsets other than Oculus.

- Correction of an error with the positioning.

- Basic corrections.
